android.desc:
The Visions application allows you to imagine how a person with a visual disease sees their environment thanks to a live simulator.

A complementary tool for raising awareness of low vision, it allows you to imagine more complex situations in everyday life by combining vision disorders and pathologies.

Finally, the application also allows you to understand the main stages of healthy vision development in your child and use the selfie mode to visualize how he or she perceives you.

Diseases:
- Cataract
- AMD
- Glaucoma
- Retinitis pigmentosa
- Diabetic retinopathy

Visual disorders:
- Visual acuity from 10% to 100%
- Glare & contrasts
- Peripheral visual field deficit by quadrant: hemianopia and quadranopia
- Concentric peripheral visual field defect
- Central visual field defect
- Polyopia
